events.event: Korlantas Polri starts Operasi Patuh 2026 on 26 October, running to 8 November, with wrong-way (lawan arus) riding and driving as the main target.
events.key_numbers: 26 Oct-8 Nov 2026 (14 days) · focus: lawan arus · tilang supervised by Provos (per Wartakini)
events.why_it_matters: Millions of motorists and ojol drivers can be ticketed from Monday, so the rules and fines are worth knowing.
events.spreading_evidence: Reported by CNN Indonesia, Sindonews, Periskop, Tribrata News on 24 Oct

events.event: Hunter's Moon (full moon) rises on the evening of 26 October, and BMKG warns coastal residents of tidal flooding (rob) around the full moon.
events.key_numbers: Moonrise 17:53 WIB 26 Oct · peak 23:58 WIB · moonset 05:10 WIB 27 Oct · best viewing from ~20:00 WIB
events.why_it_matters: A visible night-sky event on Monday, with a rob risk for coastal towns such as north Jakarta.
events.spreading_evidence: CNBC Indonesia article 24 Oct; wider coverage by regional outlets

events.event: BMKG's weekly outlook for 20-26 October says hot, dry weather continues under a very strong El Nino and positive IOD, with heavy rain alerts only for Aceh and Papua Pegunungan (23-26 Oct); the next weekly outlook is due around 26-27 October.
events.key_numbers: Max temp 38.5 C West Java (17 Oct) · Central Kalimantan hotspots 157 to 937 (18 to 19 Oct) · West Kalimantan 31 to 231 · South Sumatra 19 to 66 · East Java 10 to 36 · heavy-rain alert 23-26 Oct: Aceh, Papua Pegunungan · strong winds: Java, South Sumatra, Lampung, South Kalimantan, South Sulawesi
events.why_it_matters: It tells people why the haze is not clearing and which areas still face heat, fire, or sudden storms this week.

events.event: BMKG head Teuku Faisal Fathani says the 2026/27 rainy season will arrive late, in November for some areas and December for others, with Central Kalimantan expected mid to late November; peak is December-February with more frequent heavy rain.
events.key_numbers: Rainy season onset: Nov-Dec 2026 · Central Kalimantan: mid to late Nov · peak Dec-Feb · total rainfall near 30-year normal but season shorter
events.why_it_matters: It means weeks more of smoke and fire risk, then a sharp switch to flood and landslide season.
events.spreading_evidence: Several outlets (CNN Indonesia, Periskop, regional NU/Jateng) 21-24 Oct

events.event: Central Kalimantan's emergency command post reports cumulative karhutla totals through 23 October, while thick smoke still covers Palangka Raya and Palembang and the Health Minister urges KN95 masks.
events.key_numbers: Kalteng cumulative to 23 Oct: 6,952 incidents, 20,108.18 ha · 23 Oct alone: 51 incidents, 140.31 ha · Palangka Raya cumulative: 957 incidents, 1,286.94 ha · Palangka Raya emergency status to 9 Nov (E0249)
events.why_it_matters: Smoke is hurting health, schools and traders' income, and the fire count is still rising.
events.spreading_evidence: CNN Indonesia nasional: 5 of 20 latest headlines on karhutla/haze (24 Okt); Antara terkini

events.event: A fire on Gunung Ciremai (Kuningan, West Java) is reported at 10 fire points, and the West Java provincial government deploys water-bombing helicopters after the fire spread from about 5 hectares to tens of hectares.
events.key_numbers: Fire first seen night of 21 Oct · from ~5 ha to tens of ha (23 Oct) · 10 fire points (24 Oct, per CNN Indonesia headline) · altitude ~1,000 m asl
events.why_it_matters: The fires are now on a Java mountain close to dense population, not only in Kalimantan and Sumatra.
events.spreading_evidence: Three separate CNN Indonesia headlines on 24 Oct

events.event: Police in Tangerang Selatan investigate alleged bullying and extortion of 14 female students at SMP Negeri 10 Tangsel (Ciputat), reportedly forced by senior students to drink a homemade mixture; 3 needed hospital care.
events.key_numbers: 14 victims · 3 hospitalised · demanded Rp5,000-10,000 each · mixture reportedly vinegar, garlic, coffee (unconfirmed extras)
events.why_it_matters: Parents want to know what schools and police must do when bullying turns into physical harm.
events.spreading_evidence: Viral per Kumparan; multiple outlets (CNN, Kumparan, Kabar6, Metropolitan) 24 Oct

events.event: Two SPPG (MBG free-meal kitchen) employees in Sumenep were arrested by police for allegedly taking meth (sabu) inside an MBG kitchen, according to Detik's most-read list.
events.key_numbers: 2 SPPG staff arrested · Sumenep, East Java
events.why_it_matters: MBG food safety and kitchen supervision are already under scrutiny, and this adds a new angle.

events.event: Pollster IPO releases a survey finding 66 percent of the public satisfied with Prabowo's performance, with Gerindra topping party electability and PSI at 2.9 percent; Amran is rated the best minister and Raja Juli the worst.
events.key_numbers: 66% satisfied with Prabowo · PSI electability 2.9% · Gerindra highest, then PDIP and Golkar · best minister Amran, most popular Bahlil, worst Raja Juli
events.why_it_matters: It is the latest public read on how voters rate the government after its second anniversary.
events.spreading_evidence: Five separate CNN Indonesia headlines on the survey, 24 Okt
